title: nf-core/rnastructurome pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

organism.description: Organism name used for transcript reference resolution. Latin binomials such as 'Homo sapiens' are normalised to Ensembl species format.

pH.description: pH of the DMS reaction. When method is 'dms' and pH >= 8.0, reactive bases are set to 'ACGU' (all four bases); otherwise defaults to 'AC'.

condition.description: Sample condition for rf-norm grouping (treated / untreated / denatured). Samples are normalised only against rows with the same sample_group and replicate. Untreated requires a matching treated sample; denatured requires matching treated and untreated samples.
condition.help_text: TODO (rnacentral-probing-metadata-main): merge_metadata.py must be updated to populate this column from the YAML 'conditions' field. Until then, samples without a condition are treated as 'treated'.

sample_group.description: sample_group identifier used by rf-norm pairing. Only samples with the same sample_group and replicate are normalised together.
sample_group.help_text: Populate this column for all rf-norm inputs. rf-norm will error if sample_group is missing.

replicate.description: Replicate identifier used by rf-norm pairing. Only samples with the same sample_group and replicate are normalised together.
replicate.help_text: Populate this column for all rf-norm inputs. rf-norm will error if replicate is missing. Use a stable value such as rep1, rep2, or 1. Matching is exact after Nextflow converts the value to text.

group.description: Deprecated legacy rf-norm grouping key. rf-norm now requires explicit sample_group and replicate columns instead.
group.help_text: Retained only for input compatibility while upstream metadata generators are updated. It is not used by rf-norm.
